- [2023/05/24] The quadrature of the circle is a historical problem involving constructing a square with the same area as a given circle.
- [2023/05/24] Hippocrates of Chios (470 - 410 BC) attempted to solve the quadrature of the circle using moon-shaped figures, but his method was ultimately unsuccessful.
- [2023/05/24] Euclid's "The Elements," written around 300 BC, is a foundational text in geometry and has significantly influenced Western culture.
- [2023/05/24] "The Elements" was not a textbook in the modern sense; it was copied and modified over time, with surviving copies containing commentaries.
- [2023/05/24] The original text of "The Elements" by Euclid is unknown; the closest examples are from Arabian sources and Greek text fragments from 100 AD.
- [2023/05/24] Book II of "The Elements" introduces the problem of the quadrature of the circle.
- [2023/05/24] Book XIII of "The Elements" concludes with the theorem that there are exactly five regular or Platonic solids.
- [2023/05/24] Euclid's work in "The Elements" focuses on reasoning and constructing geometric figures without calculation, reflecting ancient ideas of geometria.
- [2023/05/24] Books VII-X of "The Elements" cover topics related to number theory, with the Euclidean algorithm for calculating the greatest common divisor.
- [2023/05/24] Books XI-XIII of "The Elements" address the geometry of solids, including a proof that circles are in ratio to one another as the squares on their diagonals.

- [2023/05/26] Fault Tree Analysis (FTA) is a risk management technique used to identify and analyze possible causes of specific failures.
- [2023/05/26] FTA was developed by Bell Labs in the 1960s and was first used to analyze telecommunications systems.
- [2023/05/26] H.A. Watson of Bell Labs is credited as the inventor of Fault Tree Analysis, publishing the first paper on it in 1961.
- [2023/05/26] FTA is used in industries such as aerospace, nuclear power, chemical processing, and software engineering to manage risks.
- [2023/05/26] FTA involves constructing a tree diagram based on Boolean logic and combinatorial mathematics, which are areas of discrete mathematics.
- [2023/05/26] The main benefit of FTA is its systematic approach to risk analysis, while its disadvantages include being time-consuming and requiring expertise.
